podcast.title: Flourishing in the 1990s
podcast.body: American indie music was a vibrant component of the diverse music landscape between 1991 and 1995. This period saw a proliferation of new sounds and scenes, contributing to the "wild ride" of musical innovation. "that's grunge, that's American indie..."

podcast.title: Pixies' Surfer Rosa - Pioneering Status
podcast.body: Pixies' album *Surfer Rosa* was instrumental in establishing them as pioneers of American indie music. Its unique and innovative sound led many media outlets to name it Album of the Year, solidifying its influential status. "El álbum los colocaría como abandonados del Indioamericano y sería considerado disco del año por muchos medios."
